name: double-click-toggles-fullscreen
description: Double-clicking the picture toggles window mode - the gesture a viewer uses to go fullscreen.

steps.note: The picture is the whole of the window, so this is a double-click on the video itself.
Bounded settle between the two gestures; the assertions below carry the scenario.
The same gesture again, so the assertion can tell a toggle from a one-way set.
Bounded settle after the second gesture.

assertions.note: The shell's own answer to the gesture. mouseDoubleClickEvent (PlayerShell.cpp:1366) calls windowModeToggled (655-663), which flips fullscreen_ and emits this. The surface is a child of the shell and forwards its own double-click (PlayerShell.cpp:1540), so this fails if the gesture is dropped anywhere on that path.
The gesture toggles rather than sets: two double-clicks mean two announcements. A build that opened fullscreen once and then stopped responding would satisfy the assertion above and fail here.
